# Blomi

> Blomi is a cycle-aware monthly planner for women. It aligns tasks — meetings, workouts, travel, deep work — with the four phases of the menstrual cycle (menstruation, follicular, ovulation, luteal) so energy-intensive activities land on high-energy days.

- [Home](/): What Blomi is and how cycle-aware planning works.
